raw_gold.why_gold: Concise, outcome-specific headline with a concrete timeframe — ready for ads, subject lines, and social posts.
National-level credential that immediately establishes elite authority — a climber reading this knows 5.14c is world-class.
Specific number creates tangibility and implies depth of methodology — far more credible than vague 'science-backed' claims.
Core promise of the product — grade-specific outcome with a time guarantee, the central selling proposition.

raw_gold.text: Featured in Rock and Ice magazine
raw_gold.why_gold: Third-party media validation from the most recognized climbing publication — strong social proof for the niche audience.
Dual credential combining academic physiotherapy expertise with elite athlete sponsorship — bridges science and sport credibility.
Clean, repeatable phrase that positions the program against intuition-based coaching — useful as a recurring descriptor.
Directly names the core frustration of the target audience — plateau is the most emotionally loaded word for intermediate climbers.

raw_gold.text: climbers aspiring to reach advanced grades
raw_gold.why_gold: Captures the aspirational identity of the target audience — they see themselves as serious climbers held back from their potential.
Two-word phrase that contrasts with the randomness most climbers experience in training — implies structure and predictability.

raw_gold.text: Ofer Blutrich (M.Sc PT, Black Diamond Pro) uses 113 evidence-based protocols to get climbers to V6 in 90 days
raw_gold.why_gold: Complete authority-to-outcome sentence — coach name, credentials, method specificity, and promise all in one line.
Direct call-to-action combined with elite credential — implies access to a level of coaching normally out of reach.
Addresses the secondary fear of every climber pushing grades — getting hurt. Differentiates from pure performance coaching.
Captures the integrated service model — the combination of PT and climbing coaching is the structural differentiator.
Implies a diagnostic-first approach — signals professionalism and personalization rather than one-size-fits-all programming.

gold_summary: The strongest messaging angles center on three pillars: elite personal credibility (Israel's first 5.14c climber, Black Diamond Pro, Rock and Ice featured), a specific and measurable outcome promise (V6 in 90 days), and scientific methodology depth (113 evidence-based protocols). The integration of physiotherapy credentials with elite climbing achievement creates a unique authority position — this is not just a strong climber coaching, but a sports scientist who also happens to be the best climber in the country. The emotional core targets intermediate climbers stuck at a plateau who crave structured, predictable progression.
